krechik2020-malvinas-normalized-jet-dept.source_citation: Krechik,V.A.(2020),The upper layer of the Malvinas/Falkland current:Structure,and transport near46S inJanuary2020,Russian Journal of Earth Sciences20,ES5005.
krechik2020-malvinas-normalized-jet-dept.source_text_excerpt: surface to about 400 m;50-480 m depth range
krechik2020-malvinas-normalized-jet-dept.velocity_definition: Meridional SADCP velocities normalized by whole-dataset mean;jet Vnorm>1,core Vnorm>2.
krechik2020-malvinas-normalized-jet-dept.site_scope: Section described as45degrees48minutesS inStudySite and46S inData;do not resolve this discrepancy by invented station coordinates.
krechik2020-malvinas-normalized-jet-dept.source_depth_cutoff_rule: Relative normalization;not an absolute fixed velocity cutoff.
krechik2020-malvinas-normalized-jet-dept.source_limits: Sampled support starts17.6m andends460-500m;surface wording does not prove0m observations,and480m jet endpoint may be support-limited. No physical bottom or thickness.
